notes.summary: ChatLocale gained required keys in 0.17.2. A hand-written full ChatLocale object no longer compiles and misses texts until it has them. Partial<ChatLocale> overrides are unaffected.
notes.howTo: Add these keys to every full ChatLocale object: approvalCollidingIdWarning. English and German defaults ship with the SDK; the locale and locales props of AiChatProvider take Partial<ChatLocale>, so partial tables need no change.

notes.summary: ToolSearchIndex gained the method rank(query, limit). A hand-written object typed as ToolSearchIndex no longer compiles; indexes from createToolSearchIndex have it.
notes.howTo: Implement rank(query, limit) returning ToolSearchHit[] (the hits of search with exact and score), or build the index with createToolSearchIndex.

notes.summary: An id the conversation showed for records of different kinds is now an ambiguous ApprovalSubject without name and with candidates ({ label, name? }[]), and the card warns instead of naming one record.
notes.howTo: A custom approval card should list candidates and name none when they are present; do not assume name is set.

notes.summary: The examples of .glirastes/tool-semantics.json now reach the tool search, so the generated module changes for apps with examples and glirastes tools check reports drift until glirastes tools refresh.
notes.howTo: Run glirastes tools refresh, review and commit the diff. Runtime container artifacts load unchanged and gain the examples. Examples stay local and are never sent to the Platform.
